title: Uniform average cost for majority
statement: Let $T$ be a finite decision tree on three sign-valued coordinates, with sign-valued outputs, that computes majority on three signs (with ties assigned the positive sign). Under the uniform distribution on the eight inputs, the expected number of queries made by $T$ is at least $5/2$.
